display.purpose: Self-hosted extra-bold italic face for page titles, established display labels, trainer names and timers; italic/uppercase is component styling.

body.purpose: Existing Source Sans 3 stack for controls and prose.

motion.name: page-entry
motion.purpose: Seven-pixel page arrival; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: contact-ring
motion.purpose: Ordinary/strong first-hit rings in ordinary real-time Show; existing real-seconds Show delta while playing, stationary reduced-motion shape.

motion.name: fighter-release
motion.purpose: Ordinary RT release, block and genuine-miss dodge acting; renderer delta follows pause, replay speed and hit-stop. Four fixed slots; no added spatial transform with reduced motion.

motion.name: fighter-recovery
motion.purpose: Hit recoil / healing lift around source art; one decelerating recovery, strongest simultaneous hit impulse, neutral direction for ambiguous doubles. Ground anchors and special choreography remain authoritative.

motion.name: damage-figure
motion.purpose: Condensed italic burst total with ×N, brief scale accent, short rise and late fade; renderer delta follows pause and replay speed. Reduced motion retains a stationary, unscaled figure.

narrative.overview:
Slate metal surfaces, silver text and warm gold selections frame the existing Silver emblem, trainer portraits and supplied Pokémon sprites. Condensed italic display lettering gives menus and battle names weight; compact sans-serif controls keep the dense tools readable. Cyan and coral identify the two battle corners.

This is a descriptive record of the current implementation, reconciled with the reference-led direction in `.impeccable/surfaces/client-src-app-jsx.md`. The authoritative presentation layer is `client/src/arcade.css`, over the shared theme, `index.css`, `app.css` and existing battle styles. `App.jsx`, `Inicio.jsx`, `Combatir.jsx` and the ordinary real-time show renderer demonstrate its use; captures in `.impeccable/review/` record desktop, mobile, home, classic and real-time surfaces. No separate approved comp or quality-bar card is claimed.
keyCharacteristics: Slate layers and silver text with warm gold active states.
Self-hosted condensed italic display lettering beside compact sans-serif controls.
Existing emblem, trainer portraits and pixel sprites as the visual identity.
Cyan/coral battle corners, bevelled controls and restrained selection lifts.
Bounded body acting and readable damage bursts in ordinary real-time combat.

rules.name: The Corner Continuity Rule
rules.body: Carry cyan and coral consistently from the two setup seats into battle information; retain text names and labels alongside color.

rules.name: The Display Separation Rule
rules.body: Use condensed italic lettering for the established display roles; keep instructions, fields and dense working controls in the existing sans-serif family.

rules.name: The Presentation Clock Rule
rules.body: Advance ordinary RT body acting, particles and damage figures with the renderer's pause- and replay-speed-aware delta; keep Show overlays on their existing real-seconds delta, and reset transient owners on replay seek.

rules.name: The Existing Material Rule
rules.body: Preserve atlas geometry, transparent source pixels, provenance, declared display scales and visible still frames; add presentation around the supplied art without rewriting combat rules.

dos: Do use slate surfaces, silver text and gold selected states from the current presentation layer.
Do keep cyan/coral corners, readable trainer names and accurate team previews together.
Do preserve existing routes, controls, language support, music behavior and gameplay while refining presentation.
Do retain keyboard focus, reduced motion and the shared presentation clock.
Do preserve supplied-sprite provenance and pixel geometry.
donts: Don't restore the stale brown/crimson palette or Cinzel page headings as the current global identity.
Don't use display lettering for dense instructions or replace semantic type/status colors with corner colors.
Don't imply that ordinary real-time rings and body acting also add a new mass-battle or classic effect layer.
Don't claim that already exported HTML updates without re-exporting it.
